 * header/region.phtml splits the cookie on "~" into meta tags before any ad
 * tag runs:
 *
 *   ____rg=US~NY~        → country=US, region=NY, privacy=
 *   ____rg=US~CA~ccpa    → country=US, region=CA, privacy=ccpa
 *   ____rg=DE~~gdpr      → country=DE, region=,   privacy=gdpr

 * publishes (historical contract: "gdpr" and/or "ccpa"). An empty privacy
 * field means the worker did not attach a regime. US/NY is empty.
 *

    'AT',
    'BE',
    'BG',
    'HR',
    'CY',
    'CZ',

function metaContent(doc, name) {
    if (!doc || typeof doc.querySelector !== 'function') return undefined;
    try {
        const el = doc.querySelector(`meta[name="${name}"]`);
        if (!el || typeof el.getAttribute !== 'function') return undefined;
        const value = el.getAttribute('content');
        return value == null ? '' : String(value);
    } catch (e) {
        return undefined;
    }

function parseRgValue(raw) {
    if (raw == null || raw === '') return null;
    let decoded = String(raw);
    try {
        decoded = decodeURIComponent(decoded);
    } catch (e) {}
    const parts = decoded.split('~');
    if (!parts[0]) return null;
    return {
        country: parts[0],
        region: parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : '',
        privacy: parts.length > 2 ? parts[2] : '',

    let cookie = '';
    try {

    if (!cookie) return null;
    const match = cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)____rg=([^;]*)/);

    return parseRgValue(match[1]);

function blank(extra) {
    return Object.assign(
        {
            decision: 'unknown',
            reason: 'missing',
            source: 'none',
            country: '',
            region: '',
            privacy: '',
            ccpa: false,
        },
        extra || {},

/**
 * @param {{ country?: string, region?: string, privacy?: string, parsed?: boolean, source?: string }} input

function classifyConsentGeo(input) {
    const src = input || {};
    if (!src.parsed) return blank({ source: src.source || 'none', reason: 'missing' });

    const country = String(src.country || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const region = String(src.region || '');
    const privacy = String(src.privacy || '');

        source: src.source || 'none',
        country,
        region,
        privacy,
        ccpa: false,
    };

        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/[\s,]+/)

    base.ccpa = ccpa;

    if (tokens.indexOf('gdpr') !== -1) {

        source: 'cookie',

}
